item.title: Bulletin updated at 07:50 HKT 28/Aug/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Under the dominance of an anticyclone aloft, it will be mainly fine and very hot over southern China today and tomorrow. With the weakening of the anticyclone aloft, showers will increase over the region in the middle and latter parts of this week. Moreover, a weak northeast monsoon will affect the coast of Guangdong in the latter part of this week.

Date/Month: 28/08 (Sunday)
Wind: Light winds force 2, east force 3 later.
Weather: Mainly fine. Very hot during the day. Isolated showers later.
Temp range: 28 - 34 C
R.H. range: 60 - 90 per Cent
PSR: Low
